item.title: The BEAM Is a Friendly Host: C, Rust, Svelte and WebGPU Next to Elixir
item.author: lalabuy9948@gmail.com (Daniil Popov)
item.description:
A few weeks ago I wrote down my talk on how one phone becomes a broadcast camera. This is the other end of that cable, from the second talk I gave this year, this time to an Elixir crowd at Goatmire.

I am not going to pitch Elixir. I am going to tell you how a small dashboard on a camera control panel turned into a color studio, and how every time the problem got harder, we added a neighbor language next to Elixir instead of rewriting.

Elixir is in every part of this story. It is the star in none of them. That is the point.

item.title: CyanCamera: Turning an iPhone Into a Broadcast Camera
item.author: lalabuy9948@gmail.com (Daniil Popov)
item.description: I gave a 20-minute talk this year at RTCON by Software Mansion on the color science behind CyanCamera, the app we built at CyanView that lets an iPhone sit next to a Sony Venice or an ARRI Alexa in a live broadcast truck. This post is that talk, written down.
